item.title: A visit to the home of the Gods
item.description:
… the Twelve Olympian Gods to be more exact 🙂

I haven’t really got to meet any of them, but I’m sure they were there 😛

But even without actually meeting the Gods, I spent a great long summer weekend that had all the best ingredients: sun, sea, beach, cold beer, great seafood, mountains and islands 🙂

item.title: 10 things I learned while roadtripping to Mont Blanc
item.description:
“Travel is the best teacher.”

Together with some friends, I recently took a roadtrip to Mont Blanc. We climbed the highest peak in western Europe and then returned home through Venice 🙂 Here are the most important life lessons I’ve learned from this trip:
